summary: Aflac Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of senior notes. The filing is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration. Terms are left blank (principal amount, interest rate, maturity to be determined). Notes are unsecured, rank equally with existing senior debt, and will not be listed. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a standard financing, not a special situation. No special-situation elements present.
